subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Perterb.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of 'Perterb' according to the English dictionary is '**Perturb**'.
 
• The word 'Perturb' means '**to make somebody worried or upset**'.
 
• ​Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'Perterb'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
 
• **Perceive**- to notice or realize something.
 
• **Pigeon**- a fat grey bird that often lives in towns.
 
• **Passive**- showing no reaction, feeling or interest; not active.
